vbaCodeBehind:
Option Compare Database

Private Sub AddNewBtn_Click()
   On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    Dim hadRows As Boolean
    hadRows = (Me.RecordsetClone.RecordCount > 0)

    ' Sort newest-first
    Me.OrderBy = "[EventDate] DESC"
    Me.OrderByOn = True
    Me.AllowAdditions = True

    ' Save any edits on the current row
    If Me.Dirty Then Me.Dirty = False

    If hadRows Then
        ' Duplicate current record (copies required/filter fields so new row stays visible)
        DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdSelectRecord
        DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdCopy
        DoCmd.RunCommand acCmdPasteAppend   ' focus is now on the NEW record
    Else
        ' No rows yet—just start a new one
        DoCmd.GoToRecord , , acNewRec
    End If

    ' --- We are on the NEW record now ---
    Me!EventDate = Now

    ' Blank these fields (use Null; fall back to "" if the field disallows Nulls)
    On Error Resume Next
    Me!LogParalegal = Null
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then Err.Clear: Me!LogParalegal = vbNullString
    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    On Error Resume Next
    Me!EventDescription = Null
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then Err.Clear: Me!EventDescription = vbNullString
    On Error GoTo Err_Handler

    ' Save the new record
    If Me.Dirty Then Me.Dirty = False

    ' Requery to enforce sort, then go to the top (which should be this record)
    Me.Requery
    With Me.RecordsetClone
        If .RecordCount > 0 Then
            .MoveFirst
            Me.Bookmark = .Bookmark
        End If
    End With

Exit_Handler:
    Exit Sub

Err_Handler:
    MsgBox "Error " & Err.Number & ": " & Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Add New Record"
    Resume Exit_Handler
End Sub
Private Function BuildEqCriteria(ByVal FieldName As String, ByVal v As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(v) Then
        BuildEqCriteria = "[" & FieldName & "] IS NULL"
    ElseIf VarType(v) = vbString Then
        BuildEqCriteria = "[" & FieldName & "]=" & Chr$(34) & Replace(v, Chr$(34), Chr$(34) & Chr$(34)) & Chr$(34)
    ElseIf VarType(v) = vbDate Then
        BuildEqCriteria = "[" & FieldName & "]=#" & Format$(v, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss") & "#"
    Else
        BuildEqCriteria = "[" & FieldName & "]=" & v
    End If
End Function

Private Sub Form_Load()
    Me.OrderBy = "[EventDate] DESC"
    Me.OrderByOn = True
End Sub

Private Sub Form_MouseWheel(ByVal Page As Boolean, ByVal Count As Long)
 If Not Me.Dirty Then
   If (Count < 0) And (Me.CurrentRecord > 1) Then
     DoCmd.GoToRecord , , acPrevious
   ElseIf (Count > 0) And (Me.CurrentRecord < Me.Recordset.RecordCount) Then
        DoCmd.GoToRecord , , acNext
   End If
 Else
   MsgBox "The record has changed. Save the current record before moving to another record.", , "TB CMS"
 End If
End Sub
